title: Contingency Switchboard: multi-signal sentinel for overload and graceful variant cutover
creator: Asha Patel
description: Goal: implement a compact, configurable Contingency Switchboard that synthesizes multiple real-time signals (429 spikes, p95/p99 latency windows, request timeouts, error-rate, queue depth) into a single 'stress score' per route/tenant/region. The switchboard will drive automatic, rate-limited fallback actions: soft-open circuit breakers, progressive model-variant eviction (to quantized / lower-capacity variants), regional cutover to alternate tiers, and canary probes for recovery. This ticket covers design, config model, initial runtime integration, and a staged rollout plan.
implementation_plan: 1) Define normalized signals and scoring function (weights configurable by route). 2) Implement streaming signal aggregator in routing plane (sampled per-tenant). 3) Add hysteresis and decay windows to avoid flapping. 4) Implement action executor: soft-open CB, model-variant swap, per-tenant probation windows, and probe-based recovery. 5) Add dashboarding and alerting. 6) Run safety soak on staging and gradually ramp in production via canary routes.
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Use a composite stress score rather than many independent thresholds to reduce oscillation and centralize policy reasoning.
Prefer soft-open circuit breakers with percentage-based traffic steering over hard-cutoff to preserve degraded but useful capacity.
Per-tenant sensitivity will be supported but default to conservative weights to minimize false positives impacting availability.
Simpler deterministic scoring was chosen for initial rollout over a ML classifier to ensure explainability and easy debugging; ML classifier is flagged as a follow-up (see linked_artifacts).
signals_normalized: token-serving-backpressure signals (KV cache miss ratios, batching delays)
scoring_details: Score = w1*429_rate_norm + w2*timeout_norm + w3*tail_latency_norm + w4*error_rate_norm + w5*queue_depth_norm. Default weights: w1=0.30, w2=0.25, w3=0.20, w4=0.15, w5=0.10. Configurable per-route and per-tenant in console. Score maps to actions via policy bands (observe, throttle, soft-open, escalate).
actions_and_policies: Observe: only emit alerts and enrich traces
Throttle: apply route-level rate limiting and configurable backoff headers
Soft-open CB: probabilistically route X% of traffic to fallback model or lower-cost tier; maintain control-plane override
Variant eviction: shift new requests to smaller/CPU/quantized model variants while allowing in-flight KV cache reuse where compatible
Regional cutover: steer to alternate region/availability tier with capacity check and per-tenant weighting
Canary probes: run active sample requests against candidate variant/region to validate recovery before full rollback of the CB
hysteresis_and_decay: Detection windows: 30s short window + 5m medium window for escalation. Recovery decay uses exponential backoff with minimum probation window of 2m for soft-open and 10m for regional cutover. Tuneable in config and exposed in console.
observability_and_alerting: Add a 'stress_score' timeseries per route/tenant/region, expose top contributing signals, and surface an auto-generated incident suggestion when score enters 'escalate' band. Dashboards: per-route heatmap, tenant impact table, recent CB actions log. Alerting: two thresholds (notify ops, trigger runbook) with runbook link.
runbook_and_playbooks: Attach runbook: Confluence > SmartRouting/Contingency-Switchboard-Runbook. Playbooks include immediate diagnostics, forced rollback steps, and traffic cutover commands.
testing_plan: Unit tests for scoring function and config parsing
Integration tests that replay historical telemetry traces and assert expected actions
Chaos tests: induced 429 storms and artificial timeouts in staging to verify soft-open and recovery probes
Load soak with shadow traffic for 48h before production ramp
acceptance_criteria: Config API available and validated by backend integration tests
Switchboard emits stress_score with correct normalization for at least 5 representative routes
Soft-open action correctly routes configured percent to fallback and respects per-tenant overrides
Canary probes validate recovery before full rollback in automated tests
No observable increase in global error rates when switchboard is enabled in shadow mode for 48h
Documentation and runbook published and linked in ticket
risks_and_mitigations: False positives may unnecessarily divert traffic: mitigation = conservative defaults, per-tenant opt-outs, and human-in-the-loop policy escalation
Model-variant incompatibility (structured output mismatch): mitigation = variant compatibility checks and schema validation before swap
Telemetry gaps can skew score: mitigation = fallback to single-signal guardrails and fail-open behavior for scoring service
Operational complexity: mitigation = incremental rollout, strong dashboards, and one-click rollback
